evidence.claim: By August 2026, Ghana had 85.8 million registered mobile money accounts, more than twice the population.
evidence.checked_by: Claude (independent source check, at GilB request)

evidence.claim: In August 2026 alone, mobile money processed over one billion transactions, nearly 400 every second on average.
evidence.checked_by: Claude (independent source check, at GilB request)

evidence.claim: As of August 2026, the Bank of Ghana classified 26.4 million accounts as active, fewer than one in three; the other 59.4 million were not.
evidence.checked_by: Claude (independent source check, at GilB request)

evidence.claim: The Bank of Ghana considers an account active if it has recorded at least one transaction in the previous 90 days.
evidence.checked_by: Claude (independent source check, at GilB request)

evidence.claim: Between August 2025 and August 2026, registered accounts increased by 8.1 million and active accounts by 1.3 million, so the gap widened by almost 7 million.
evidence.checked_by: Claude (independent source check, at GilB request)
evidence.qualification: 77.7 to 85.8; 25.1 to 26.4; not-active 52.6 to 59.4 (+6.8). Rounded BoG values.
